race.description: Royal George Hotel Rosewood Mdn Plate
race.comment: OSCAR (2) resumes off a solid second in a Doomben trial and his debut fourth at Doomben, beaten just over half a length, reads well for this Maiden despite the long break. BEAR OIL (1) also resumes with upside after showing early speed in both runs last campaign, and the 3kg claim gives him a practical edge if he returns forward enough. WHISKEY AND WINE (4) has placed four times from five starts and has already filled the placings at around 1100m, so he is a reliable danger if sharp enough fresh. LOVE AND PAIN (8) has four placings from four runs in the past 12 months and a wet-track placing already on the board. The six-day turnaround and return to 1100m are the qualifications, but she has been holding her form stays in the mix.
